title: Average query cost of a sequential OR tree
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, and let $p\in(0,1)$. On independent signs whose probability of being $-1$ is $p$, the expected number of queries made by the tree that queries the coordinates of $A$ in increasing order and stops at the first $-1$ (or after exhausting $A$) is $\sum_{k=0}^{|A|-1}(1-p)^k$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
